#!/usr/bin/env bash
# R1264y D1: ordinary lines that once tripped the fail-safe: case as a word, a subshell or (pattern) in a case in $(…).
n=$(grep -c case "$f")
x=$(echo case)
lines=$(git log --oneline | grep -iw case | wc -l)
msg=$(printf %s just in case)
x=$(case $1 in a) (cd / && ls) ;; esac)
x=$(case $1 in (a) echo a ;; esac)
clean="${raw//\"/}"
